english.note: Use this mainly before nouns such as 多數 or 優勢 when the overwhelming force is a decisive majority or advantage.

exampleSentences.english: The election results showed that they won an overwhelming majority.
exampleSentences.traditional: 選舉結果顯示，佢哋攞到壓倒性多數。
